text:
maria: FYI SRE flagged a rise in embeddings latency for EU customers starting ~11:05 UTC. Need a comms plan: status page copy, small-target emails, and guidance on tomorrow's webinar.
aj: Confirmed - p99 embeddings latency spike in eu-west-1 at 11:05. Engineers investigating; mitigations running. No evidence of data loss so far.
sara: Status page short option: "We're seeing increased latency for embeddings in our EU region. Engineers are investigating; no data loss expected. We'll post the next update in 30 minutes."
maria: Good. For customers with active contracts add a sentence "We're prioritizing customers with active usage and enterprise SLAs." Keep the public line concise.
ken: Support is getting several timeout reports. Recommend a Zendesk macro and routing high-usage accounts to AE on-call. I'll create macro: macro-eu-embed-2026.
dev-rel: Hold any EU-facing benchmark posts or scheduled tweets until we confirm stable. Also cancel the automated blog publish job for tomorrow 09:00 CET.
statusbot: New incident logged: INC-2026-354 - embeddings latency (eu-west-1). Draft status update pushed to staging.
aj: Proposed statuspage text (final): "Increased latency impacting the embeddings API in our EU region. Engineers are investigating; no data loss is expected. Next update in 30 minutes." Short and neutral.
sara: Add an "Impacted features" bullet in the details: - embeddings API, semantic search, vector-retrieval. Include a link to SLA credit form and a contact line for urgent cases.
lina: For leads: route any inbound trial or demo requests mentioning timeouts and accounts with >100k embeddings/month to #sales-urgent. I can stand up a quick Slack notification hook.
maria: Email cadence I propose: 1) Status page now. 2) Targeted email to accounts >100k usage in 15 minutes. 3) Hold broad customer broadcast until we confirm stable (aim for 45-60 minutes). 4) Inform registrants for tomorrow's webinar privately if we decide to postpone.
ken: Zendesk macro text ready: \n```\nSubject: Re: Embeddings latency in EU\nBody: Hi <name>,\nWe're investigating increased latency for embeddings in the EU region and prioritizing impacted customers. Please reply with any request IDs and we'll escalate to your account rep. Thanks, Support\n```\nmacro id: macro-eu-embed-2026
dev-rel: Need FR/DE/ES quick localizations for targeted emails. I can request vendor urgent translation (estimated 20-30m).
sara: Webinar advice: tell registrants privately: "Due to a regional service disruption, we're evaluating whether to proceed. We'll notify registrants directly within the hour if we need to reschedule." Don't post a public cancelation yet.
maria: Agree. Also pause the promotional webinar push (ads, organic posts). Only notify registrants if we postpone.
aj: SRE status: mitigations applied, latency trending down but p99 still elevated. Recommend polling SRE and waiting for a confirmed stable window before broad social. Next SRE update in 20 minutes.
lina: Lead routing automation ready; will filter by usage and enterprise tag. I will send a brief to #sales-urgent with affected customer list after the targeted email goes out.
ken: Support note: add status page link and SLA form to macro. Also posting to #support now.
maria: Final pre-publish checklist: 1) Status page copy approved (aj) 2) Targeted email copy + macro approved (sara + ken) 3) Translations requested (dev-rel) 4) Webinar promo paused & registrant hold plan (sara) 5) Benchmark/blog publish canceled (dev-rel) 6) Lead routing enabled (lina).
aj: All items green except translations pending. Vendor pinged.
sara: Targeted email draft (approved): \n```\nSubject: Redwood Inference  Embeddings latency in EU region\nHi <FirstName>,\nWe're currently investigating increased latency affecting the embeddings API in our Europe region. Our engineers are prioritizing impacted customers and we'll share the next status by 11:35 UTC. If you're seeing production timeouts, reply to this email and we'll route your request to your account rep.\nApologies for the disruption,\nMarketing team, Redwood Inference\n```\nmaria: Publishing status page and sending targeted email per plan. Holding wider communications until SRE confirms a stable window. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
statusbot: Status updated: partial mitigation observed, monitoring. Next update scheduled in 20 minutes.
ken: Support macros live and posted to #support.
dev-rel: Translations arriving in ~22m, will confirm when ready.
maria: Closing thread; will reopen if regression or when we schedule a public update."
